title: There is no graviton and no reason to quantize gravity

statements.text: Gravity is not a force subject to the rules of quantum field theory. In invariant set theory there is no graviton, and no reason for gravity to act as a witness of quantum entanglement. Quantizing a gravitational Lagrangian in the usual way is questioned.

sources.quote: In IST there is no such thing as a graviton.
the physical basis for contemporary programmes which apply standard field quantisation to some putative gravitational lagrangian is questioned
